hints.hint: `ls` in this shell is an alias for eza, whose `-t` takes a field (`-t modified`), so `ls -t <path>` reads the path as the field. For newest-first use `command ls -t …` / `command ls -td …` (BSD ls).
hints.evidence: 2026-10 のセッション 5 件以上で 16 回: `ls -t`, `ls -td`, `ls -lt` が `$(...)` やパイプの中で失敗し、空の結果のまま次のコマンドへ進んだ。
